Game Overview

In ABCpop, the core idea is straightforward: race against time in ABCPop, a thrilling fusion of alphabet learning and bubble-popping fun. Swiftly tap to form capital letters before bubbles reset, all while delighting in the soothing pops. With only 30 seconds on the clock, can you perfect your popping prowess? Dive in and test your speed!
